headline: Mark Brooke: Lung Foundation Australia CEO receives Bob Elphick Award for tobacco control
dek: Lung Foundation Australia said its chief executive was honoured at an Australian Council on Smoking and Health parliamentary reception in Canberra for his contribution to tobacco control.
body:
Lung Foundation Australia said in a LinkedIn post that its chief executive, Mark Brooke, has received the Bob Elphick Award at the Australian Council on Smoking and Health (ACOSH) parliamentary reception in Canberra. The organisation said the presentation took place on the previous evening.

According to the post, the award recognises an outstanding contribution to tobacco control. It honours Dr Bob Elphick, described as a pioneer in tobacco control and ACOSH's founding president. Lung Foundation Australia said the award was a special recognition of Brooke's work in tobacco and vaping advocacy.

The foundation said the reception also explored the wider illicit tobacco landscape, including criminal networks, regional drivers and the implications for Australia.

The organisation added that it was proud to see Brooke's contribution recognised.
key_quote: The award recognises an outstanding contribution to tobacco control.
